metadata.description: Tripura, home to 19 Scheduled Tribes, boasts a rich cultural heritage, particularly bamboo craftsmanship. These tribes possess unique skills in weaving, music, and making traditional bamboo tools. Preserving this knowledge is crucial to safeguarding their heritage. A museum in Khumulwng, the headquarters of the Tripura Tribal Areas Autonomous District Council (TTADC), is dedicated to documenting and conserving the cultural practices of these communities. However, the museum requires additional funds and improved facilities to continue its vital work in preserving the traditional knowledge and craftsmanship of Tripura’s indigenous tribes for future generations.
